proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: the representation of Ext_A^p(K, M) as the cohomology of a three-term Hom complex out of the finite free resolution of K, the computation of Ext_A^p(K, I^n M) by the same complex with M replaced by I^n M, and the termwise application of the Artin-Rees consequence lemma to control the images by I^{n-c} (source lines 29592-29604)

standard_prerequisites.name: For a bounded above complex F of finite free A-modules the images of Hom_A(F, I^n M) -> Hom_A(F, M) are contained in I^{n-c} Hom_A(F, M) for n >= c, with c independent of n
standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies the uniform Artin-Rees exponent termwise.

core_obligations: Represent K by a bounded above complex F of finite free A-modules; then Ext_A^p(K, M) is the cohomology of the three-term complex Hom(F^{-p+1}, M) -> Hom(F^{-p}, M) -> Hom(F^{-p-1}, M), and Ext_A^p(K, I^n M) is computed by the same complex with each finite module M replaced by I^n M (proof lines 29593-29600). The maps in the I^n M complex map into the M complex termwise, and by the Artin-Rees consequence lemma the images of Hom(F^q, I^n M) -> Hom(F^q, M) are contained in I^{n-c} Hom(F^q, M) uniformly in q and n >= c; taking cohomology preserves the containment, giving the claim (proof lines 29601-29603).
proof_roadmap: Represent K by a finite free complex and identify the Hom complexes computing both Ext groups (proof lines 29593-29600).
Apply the Artin-Rees consequence lemma termwise and take cohomology (proof lines 29601-29603).
difficulty_reason: 13 行、Ext 对 I^nM 像的 Artin-Rees 控制：K 伪凝聚，取有限自由 A-模的上方有界代表 F，Ext^p(K,M) 是三项 Hom 复形的上同调；Ext^p(K,I^nM) 由同一复形把 M 换成 I^nM 计算；由 consequence-Artin-Rees-bis 引理，各次 Hom(F^q, I^nM) -> Hom(F^q, M) 的像一致地含于 I^{n-c}·Hom(F^q,M)（n≥c），取上同调保持包含即得结论。承重全在 span 内；1 处引用作导航桩。
